title: Understanding the Transformer
subtitle: A visual guide to attention mechanisms

sentences.en: Abstract
sentences.zh: 摘要

sentences.en: The Transformer is a neural network architecture that uses attention to represent relationships between tokens in a sequence.
sentences.zh: Transformer 是一种神经网络架构，它通过注意力机制来表示序列中词元之间的关系。

sentences.en: Instead of processing words one at a time, it allows each position to gather information from other positions in parallel.
sentences.zh: 它允许每个位置并行地从其他位置获取信息，而不必逐个处理单词。

sentences.en: This short reading sample introduces the encoder-decoder structure and explains how scaled dot-product attention works.
sentences.zh: 这份简短的阅读示例介绍了编码器—解码器结构，并解释了缩放点积注意力的工作方式。

sentences.en: 1 Introduction
sentences.zh: 1 引言

sentences.en: Language contains dependencies that can span many words: a pronoun may refer to a noun that appeared much earlier.
sentences.zh: 语言中的依赖关系可以跨越许多单词：一个代词可能指向很早之前出现的名词。

sentences.en: Attention creates a direct path between these positions, allowing the model to combine local details with wider context.
sentences.zh: 注意力在这些位置之间建立了直接连接，使模型能够将局部细节与更广泛的上下文结合起来。

sentences.en: The original architecture contains an encoder that reads the input and a decoder that generates the output.
sentences.zh: 原始架构包含一个读取输入的编码器，以及一个生成输出的解码器。

sentences.en: 2 Scaled Dot-Product Attention
sentences.zh: 2 缩放点积注意力

sentences.en: Each token is mapped to a query, a key, and a value, conventionally written as Q, K, and V.
sentences.zh: 每个词元都会映射为查询、键和值，通常分别记为 Q、K 和 V。

sentences.en: The dot product between a query and a key measures their compatibility.
sentences.zh: 查询与键之间的点积用来衡量二者的匹配程度。

sentences.en: Dividing the scores by the square root of the key dimension helps keep their magnitude manageable.
sentences.zh: 将分数除以键维度的平方根，有助于控制这些分数的数量级。

sentences.en: A softmax converts these scores into nonnegative weights that sum to one.
sentences.zh: Softmax 将这些分数转换为非负权重，且权重之和为 1。

sentences.en: The weighted sum of values produces a context-sensitive representation for each query.
sentences.zh: 对值进行加权求和后，即可为每个查询得到一个与上下文相关的表示。

sentences.en: Figure 1 illustrates the flow from queries and keys to attention weights and the final output.
sentences.zh: 图 1 展示了从查询和键到注意力权重，再到最终输出的计算流程。

sentences.en: 3 Multi-Head Attention
sentences.zh: 3 多头注意力

sentences.en: Multiple attention heads apply different learned projections to the same input.
sentences.zh: 多个注意力头对同一输入应用不同的可学习投影。

sentences.en: This allows the model to represent several kinds of relationships at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这使模型能够同时表示多种不同类型的关系。

sentences.en: The outputs of the heads are concatenated and passed through a final linear projection.
sentences.zh: 各个注意力头的输出会被拼接起来，然后经过最后一个线性投影。

sentences.en: Positional information is also needed because attention alone does not specify the order of the tokens.
sentences.zh: 模型还需要位置信息，因为仅靠注意力本身无法指明词元的顺序。

sentences.en: In practice, interpreting attention weights requires care: they describe one part of the computation rather than a complete explanation of the prediction.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，解读注意力权重需要谨慎：它们描述的是计算过程的一部分，而不是对预测结果的完整解释。
